# sonrai_scope (Data Source)

Looks up the canonical scope path for anything in the cloud hierarchy: an account, GCP project, Azure subscription, OU, folder, management group, or the root itself.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Resolves a scope path from a cloud-native id.
data "sonrai_scope" "account" {
  root_scope  = "aws/r-abcd"
  resource_id = "123456789012"
}

data "sonrai_scope" "org_unit" {
  root_scope  = "aws/r-abcd"
  resource_id = "ou-abcd-1a2b3c"
}

# Bare ids resolve the same as qualified ones.
data "sonrai_scope" "gcp_project" {
  root_scope  = "gcp/organizations|1234567890"
  resource_id = "my-project"
}

output "scopes" {
  value = {
    account     = data.sonrai_scope.account.scope
    org_unit    = data.sonrai_scope.org_unit.scope
    gcp_project = data.sonrai_scope.gcp_project.scope
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `resource_id` (String) Cloud-native identifier of the thing to resolve: an AWS account id or `ou-` id, a GCP project or folder id, an Azure subscription or management group id, or the root's own id such as `r-abcd`. Ids may be given bare — `my-project` resolves the same as `projects|my-project`.
- `root_scope` (String) Cloud organization root scope to search under, for example `aws/r-abcd`.

### Optional

- `entry_type` (String) Hierarchy entry type to match, such as `account`, `organizationalUnit`, `project`, `folder`, `subscription` or `managementGroup`. Only needed when an id could name more than one kind of thing; otherwise the type that matched is reported back.

### Read-Only

- `cloud_type` (String) Cloud this entry belongs to.
- `id` (String) Same as `scope`.
- `name` (String) Display name of the account, project or subscription.
- `parent_scope` (String) Scope of the OU, folder or management group directly above this entry.
- `scope` (String) Canonical scope path. Pass this to a control resource's `scope`.
